newsitem.title: USA: WorldCom Inc Q4 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: WorldCom Inc Q4 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Q4 1996 includes $2.14 billion charge for in-process research and development related to merger with MFS on December 31, 1996. The expense includes $1.6 billion associated with UUNET and $0.54 billion related to MFS.

Q4 1996 includes other after-tax charges of $121 million for employee severance, employee compensation charges, alignment charges, and costs to exit unfavorable telecommunications contracts -- all of which will occur in 1997, the first year of combined operations.
Q4 1996 net, excluding MFS merger-related non-recurring special charges of $2.26 billion, was $119.7 million or $0.29 per share vs $79.1 million, or $0.20 per share.
Net income for 1996, before non-recurring special charges of $2.63 billion, was $414.9 million, or $1.01 per share.
1995 year net was $248.1 million, or $0.68 per share, before special dividend payment.
1995 results restated to include 1996 acquisitions of Choice Communications and BLT Technologies.

MFS stand-alone fourth quarter revenue was $391.0 million, compared with $171.1 million for the same period last year. The increase was due in part to the merger with UUNET Technologies Inc, completed August 12, 1996.
For full year 1996, MFS revenue was $1.12 billion, compared with $583.2 million for 1995.
On a pro forma basis, assuming the acquisition of MFS and UUNET occurred at the beginning of both periods, revenues for 1996 were $5.64 billion, up from pro forma revenues of $4.32 billion for 1995.
